invariants.rationale: String.length() is always non-negative, but call is only safe if name is non-null.
If name is not null, name.length() >= 0, so the sum is at least x.
If name is not null, x + name.length() is at least name.length().
Using a safe evaluation, the sum is never less than x.
The sum is never less than name.length() (or 0 if name is null).
